Command: Turn the Other Cheek and Go the Second Mile
Summary: Jesus' non-retaliation command: do not repay evil for evil; offer the other cheek, give the cloak as well, and walk the second mile.
Commandment: Do not resist evil with retaliation: if struck on one cheek, turn the other; if sued for your coat, give your cloak also; if compelled one mile, go two.
Application: Each example refuses the cycle of revenge while still naming the wrong. It is personal non-retaliation, not a ban on lawful justice or on protecting others.
Purpose: TRADITIONAL reading: to break the cycle of revenge and display the character of the kingdom rather than the honour code of the world.
